notes: Chapter 3 (Beneath the Hospital) opens in the staffed clinical wing. Scenes 01-02: Bennett hands over the inspection notice; Hale gives the security briefing at the psychiatrist's office desk. No Ward Zero entry yet in this slice; W0-B stays locked until the descent scene. Hale and the engineer accompany in the panels' text; there are no actor markers below ground.
